about_item: PACKAGE: Including 12pcs assorted gingerbread man ornaments and 4pcs gingerbread house ornaments, each comes with 20 strings for easy hanging. Every piece is unique and with great details, just looks like real gingerbread cookies
DURABLE MATERIAL: These gingerbread ornaments are made of soft rubber material, durable and great quality, will last for years' Christmas decorations
SIZE: Height for each gingerbread is suits perfect for small or medium size Christmas tree decorations

CHRISTMAS TREE ORNAMENTS: These gingerbread man ornaments have very adorable looking, so why not try a traditional decoration this year by putting these little cute gingerbread ornaments on your small Christmas tree, maybe a candy themed tree, or ginger bread wreath & garland; or use as a gift or as gift tags or giving away to friends, co-works, teachers, students, carolers, etc; or put in the treat bags for kids; or simply apply on other Christmas decorations

RELIABLE SUPPORT: We appreciate your trust and want to make sure that everything works for you. If there is any problem with our gingerbread man ornaments, please reach out to our customer service, we will treat it sincerely.

summary.text: Customers find these gingerbread man ornaments cute and perfect for tree decorations, with vibrant colors and good value for money. The size receives mixed feedback - while some say they're good for decorating, others note they're smaller than expected. The durability and material quality are also mixed, with some finding them durable and made of rubber-like material, while others report they're not very durable and made of cheap gummy rubber.

authors_reviews.title: Adorable
authors_reviews.text: These are Adorable little ornaments! They are about three inches tall, durable and flat like a cookie. It looks like they are painted on silicone base. As a senior, I wanted some small no hassle decorations in the kitchen for the holidays. These are perfect. I will be attaching them to gingham plaid ribbons tie backs for white kitchen tiers and a mini tree next to my kitchenaid stand mixer. I thought a gingerbread theme in the kitchen would be cute and festive. These are priced very well. Would recommend.
authors_reviews.author: Cathy0873
